platformSections.architectureNote: Six channel tiles (WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, Voice / IVR, Email, Web & in-app) flow down into the Orchestration engine (Routing · retries · fallback chains · rate shaping · journey logic), which feeds four capability cards: Intelligence (Intent, sentiment, summary, copilot drafts, voice agents.), Agent workspace (Unified inbox, queues, SLA timers, macros.), Analytics (Delivery, cost, CSAT, containment, per-channel funnels.), and Integrations (CRM, ERP, helpdesk, data warehouse, webhooks.).
